title: Youth Alive!
subtitle: The ministry of Winners Chapel to young adults.
about: The Youth Alive Fellowship (YAF) is the Young Adult arm of the Winners Chapel International Church Worldwide. YAF is a global youth movement with a balanced commitment to spiritual growth, personal development, and purpose-driven living, empowering and equipping young people to impact their world.
vision: Raising a Generation Alive in Spirit, Soul & Body.
mission: Upgrade and Update our Youth on Total Development in the Spirit, Soul, and Body.
